description: Representative figures for one common trim of each road vehicle, the anchors its driving metadata is fitted to: curb mass, peak power and engine speeds, gearbox, driven wheels, static front weight share, top speed, 0-100 km/h time, skidpad grip and drag area. Compiled from general knowledge of published specifications and typical road-test results, without per-row sources: treat every number as an estimate, not a certified figure. Engine speeds of electric motors, drag areas, weight distribution and the differential, tire and stability-aid entries are the least certain. Bendy vehicles are fictional and carry typical figures for their class. No source prose, tables or third-party data files are redistributed.

fields.massKg: Curb mass in kg; the tool adds a 75 kg driver.
fields.powerKw: Peak power in kW (combined system power for hybrids and electric cars).
fields.peakPowerRpm: Engine speed at peak power, rev/min. Refitted for single-speed electric cars.
fields.engine: gasoline (naturally aspirated), turbo (turbo or supercharged petrol), diesel, electric, hybrid.
fields.transmission: auto (any gearbox with fixed gears), cvt (belt CVT or power-split hybrid), single (one reduction).
fields.gears: Forward gears of an auto; 1 otherwise.
fields.drive: Driven wheels on pavement: front, rear or all.
fields.frontWeight: Share of the static weight on the front axle.
fields.topSpeedKmh: Top speed in km/h (the governed speed where limited).
fields.lateralG: Skidpad grip in g on the stock tires.
fields.dragArea: Drag coefficient times frontal area, in m².
fields.stabilityControl: Electronic stability control standard for that model year.
fields.limitedSlip: 0 open differential to 1 locked, on the driven axle.
fields.rearGripScale: Rear tire grip relative to the front (wider rear tires).
fields.offroadTires: 0 road tires to 1 mud-terrain: how much loose-surface grip the tread wins back.
